tests.title: New experiment
tests.expected: New durable experiment starts empty while prior history remains queryable.

tests.title: Speed and frequency
tests.expected: Speeds 1,2,3,60 and independent frequencies update due time without source or incident writes.

tests.title: Jump and pause
tests.expected: Nine serialized due cycles occur at minutes 3-27 and pause freezes clock and polling.

tests.title: Automatic poll
tests.expected: Exactly one scheduler-owned execution occurs when the connected query becomes due.

tests.title: Snapshots
tests.expected: Durable before/after snapshots retain source, poll, downstream, audit, delay, and cursor state.

tests.title: Shared clock
tests.expected: A02,A03,A05 age from one business clock while audit time remains server time.

tests.title: Action at poll time
tests.expected: A source action after a committed cycle remains pending until the next complete cycle.

tests.title: New experiment after history
tests.expected: A new experiment preserves all prior durable history and snapshots.

tests.title: Duplicate prevention
tests.expected: Repeated healthy polls duplicate no source observation, incident, evidence, routing, delivery, conversation, message, card, or event.

tests.title: Failed read preservation
tests.expected: Failed reads preserve trustworthy state and the next healthy cycle repairs downstream work once.

tests.title: Responsive behavior
tests.expected: Connected Dashboard and Chat pass 390,768,1440 visual, keyboard, accessibility, responsive, reduced-motion, overflow, and console review.

tests.title: Clean baseline
tests.expected: Receipt at minute 20 creates no incident or downstream alert object.

tests.title: Concurrent movements
tests.expected: Only the independently keyed overdue movement opens.

tests.title: Threshold and persistence
tests.expected: No incident at 29, one at 30, and no later duplication.

tests.title: Receipt before detection
tests.expected: Receipt before the first complete read creates no historical incident.

tests.title: Correction failure isolation
tests.expected: Failed read preserves the selected incident; healthy recovery resolves it without changing unrelated movement outcomes.

tests.title: Administrative closure
tests.expected: Audited closure preserves source truth and suppresses only the uninterrupted condition.

tests.title: Mixed population
tests.expected: Only the overdue member reaches incident and downstream state.

tests.title: Cancel and reject
tests.expected: Cancellation and rejection each terminalize the original and create one new reverse movement with a new ID and reset clock.

tests.title: Connected downstream
tests.expected: Exact recipients, deliveries, card, exact-participant conversation, message, cursor, Chat list, and Chat detail remain stable.

tests.title: Clean baseline
tests.expected: Positive first consumption at minute 10 creates no incident.

tests.title: Threshold and persistence
tests.expected: One occurrence opens at 15 and persists without duplication.

tests.title: Concurrent mixed OTs
tests.expected: Only the eligible empty active OT opens; consumed, closed, and same-machine-conflicting OTs do not.

tests.title: Correction after failed poll
tests.expected: Consumption remains pending through failure and resolves only after healthy recovery.

tests.title: Administrative closure
tests.expected: Audited closure preserves active zero-consumption source and suppresses the uninterrupted condition.

tests.title: Open-OT consumption availability
tests.expected: Open OT accepts consumption; closure blocks later consumption and resolves on the next complete poll.

tests.title: Clean baseline
tests.expected: Weighed and moved at minute 10 creates no incident.

tests.title: Threshold both reasons
tests.expected: One occurrence opens at 30 with both reasons and persists without duplication.

tests.title: Independent reasons and reel kinds
tests.expected: Produced and remnant cases open independently with one reason and exact recipients.

tests.title: Partial correction both ways
tests.expected: Both correction orders preserve one occurrence with only the outstanding reason and no downstream duplication.

tests.title: Correction after failed poll
tests.expected: Corrected source remains pending through failure and resolves only after healthy recovery.

tests.title: Administrative closure
tests.expected: Audited closure preserves unweighed and unmoved source and suppresses the uninterrupted condition.

tests.title: A05 to A02 handoff
tests.expected: Exactly one handoff movement removes the A05 movement reason and later opens one A02 incident after 30 minutes.

tests.title: Survives OT closure
tests.expected: The same occurrence survives OT closure and resolves after legal weighing and movement with preserved history.
